status.health.agenda: The agenda is slow for everyone right now (about {s} s), not your Wi-Fi. Your notes still save.
status.health.captions: Captions are slow for everyone right now, not your phone.
status.hood.title: What the Status screen tells you
status.hood.what: The Status screen says if a slow moment is your Wi-Fi or us. It shows a banner when the app is slow for everyone. It also gives one plain sentence from an AI assistant, labelled as AI-generated.
